title: Can AI Agents Interface Clinicians and Complex Models?
abstract: arXiv:2610.39681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Contemporary healthcare institutions generate daily very large amounts of data, which contain highly useful information for the improvement of work organization, planning and overall efficiency. While models and techniques to extract these insights are well known and constantly developed in mathematical biology, complex systems physics and data science, the adoption of these techniques among Clinicians and Hospital Administrators remains limited, mainly due to language and methodological divides. translated_title: AI智能体能否连接临床医生与复杂模型？
translated_abstract: 背景：当代医疗机构每天产生海量的数据，其中包含对改进工作组织、规划和整体效率极为有用的信息。尽管在数学生物学、复杂系统物理学和数据科学领域中，用于提取这些洞见的模型和技术已广为人知并不断发展，但临床医生和医院管理人员对这些技术的采用仍然有限，主要原因是语言和方法学上存在隔阂。目的：在本文中，我们实现了一个AI多智能体系统（MAS），使用户能够通过自然语言对话来使用预测模型并进行统计分析。方法：我们开发了EpidemIA，这是一个无需训练的多智能体系统，配备了由人类专家编写的模块化流行病学模型套件，可在单GPU工作站上运行。为避免向第三方传输敏感数据，该系统在本地使用了一个
tldr: 该论文开发了无需训练的多智能体系统EpidemIA，使临床医生和医院管理者能够通过自然语言对话在本地单GPU工作站上使用专家编写的流行病学预测模型与统计分析，从而弥合医疗专业人员与数据科学技术之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EpidemIA, a training-free multi-agent system that enables clinicians and hospital administrators to access expert-built epidemiological predictive models and statistical analyses through natural language conversations, running locally on a single-GPU workstation to keep sensitive data secure.
